'''Jameson''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who owned a ranch on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Relkass]]. He hired several other Humans including [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Lajar Weqill]], [[Grendles]], and [[Zonder (Relkass)|Zonder]] to hunt [[draagax]].<ref name="COG" />
